## Submission Checklist

**Code and tests**
- [ ] Program compiles and runs successfully

**Academic integrity**
- [ ] All external code, libraries, and tutorials are cited in the report and in code comments

**Security and privacy**
- [ ] No passwords, tokens, API keys, `.env` files, or private keys are included
- [ ] No grades, class lists, or sensitive personal data are included
